answers.question: While the GET /users/me/cv API call is loading the CV list, what should the BaseCVsTable show?
answers.answer: Skeleton rows (3 placeholder rows with shimmer)

answers.question: If the GET /users/me/cv API call fails, what should the BaseCVsTable display?
answers.answer: Inline error message inside the table card with a Retry button

answers.question: When the user has zero base CVs uploaded, what should the table area show?
answers.answer: Table headers visible with centered 'No primary CVs uploaded yet' text + '+ Upload New CV' CTA

answers.question: What should happen when a user hovers over a CV row in the table?
answers.answer: Row background highlight + 'View' text becomes underlined

answers.question: The 'View' action in each row — what should it do?

answers.question: The '+ Upload New CV' button on the Base CVs page — should it open the ChooseBaseCVModal (with choice buttons) or a simpler upload-only modal?

answers.question: On mobile viewports, how should the 5-column BaseCVsTable adapt?
answers.answer: Stack into card layout (one card per CV)

answers.question: The screenshot shows a 'Ready' status badge but the current UserCV type has no 'status' field. Where does the status value come from — is it a backend field, always hardcoded 'Ready', or derived client-side?
answers.answer: Backend field — the GET /users/me/cv response includes (or will include) a 'status' field reflecting CV processing state.

answers.question: The modal has 'Select uploaded CV' and 'Select generated CV' buttons. What is the difference between uploaded and generated CVs — same model with a filter, or a separate data model?
answers.answer: Separate data model — generated CVs are a distinct type (e.g., TailoredCV produced by the VPR/tailoring flow), not the same as uploaded base CVs.

answers.question: The modal 'Upload' button appears gray/disabled in the screenshot. Is this a distinct disabled color (muted brown) or the same --color-primary-action with reduced opacity?
answers.answer: Match the existing disabled pattern already defined for buttons in the design system — do not introduce a new variant.

answers.question: The sidebar label in the screenshot says 'Base CVs' but the route slug is 'cv-center'. Should the sidebar nav label change from 'CV Center' to match the screenshot?
answers.answer: Change to 'Primary CVs' — update the sidebar nav item text to 'Primary CVs'.

answers.question: The upload modal in the screenshot has no visible X close button (only a 'Cancel' button). Should an X button be added per the spec?
answers.answer: Yes — add an X close icon in the top-right corner of the modal, following the spec.

answers.question: The current CVForm and CVPreview components handle single-CV editing. With the new table-based design, are these components being removed or repurposed?
answers.answer: Move to /cv-center/[cvId] detail route — keep them but relocate to the CV detail/preview page accessible via the table's 'View' action.
